card.name: Atum (The Solipsist)
card.power: Autogenesis: Player creates a new rule from thin air.
card.lore: Created himself to avoid paying union dues to parents. The ultimate freelancer.

line: Atum, Autogenesis: new rule from thin air; ultimate freelancer, no union dues.
spokenText: Atum, Autogenesis: new rule from thin air; ultimate freelancer, no union dues.

card.name: Nun (The Soup)
card.power: Reset Board: Flush all active cards. Return to the void.
card.lore: Infinite dark water. The unscripted pre-show where nothing matters.

line: Nun, Reset Board: return to void; infinite dark water, unscripted pre-show.
spokenText: Remember Nun, Reset Board: return to void; infinite dark water, unscripted pre-show.

card.name: Shu (The Airhead)
card.power: Wall of Wind: Blocks all flying attacks. Separates tag teams.
card.lore: Got the job of holding his kids apart. Literally the atmosphere in the room.

line: Shu, Wall of Wind: blocks flying attacks, separates tag teams; holding kids apart.
spokenText: Shu, Wall of Wind: blocks flying attacks, separates tag teams; holding kids apart.

card.name: Tefnut (The Spitter)
card.power: Corrosive Spit: Destroys one Equipment Card.
card.lore: Born from a god's loogie. Moisture farming with extreme prejudice.

line: Tefnut, Corrosive Spit: Equipment destroyed; born from a god's loogie.
spokenText: Tefnut, Corrosive Spit: Equipment destroyed; born from a god's loogie.

card.name: Geb (The Floor)
card.power: Earthquake Laughter: Shake the table. If cards fall, they are destroyed.
card.lore: The Earth Father. His laugh destroys cities. Has a goose on his head for reasons.

line: Geb, Earthquake Laughter: shake table; laugh destroys cities, goose on head.
spokenText: You know Geb, Earthquake Laughter: shake table; laugh destroys cities, goose on head.

card.name: Nut (The Ceiling)
card.power: Star Fall: Drop a handful of tokens. Damage equals hits.
card.lore: The Sky Mother. Eats the sun every night. Digesting a star is heartburn central.

line: Nut, Star Fall: tokens drop; eats sun every night, heartburn central.
spokenText: Nut, Star Fall: tokens drop; eats sun every night, heartburn central.

card.name: Ra (The CEO)
card.power: Executive Order: Change the turn order. It's good to be the King.
card.lore: Travels the sky in a yacht. Sent a lion to eat humanity because they stopped clapping.

line: Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, they stopped clapping.
spokenText: Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, they stopped clapping.

card.name: Khepri (The Pusher)
card.power: Resurrection Roll: Retrieve one card from the discard pile.
card.lore: Moves the sun by treating it like a ball of poop. It's a living.

line: Khepri, Resurrection Roll, retrieves card? Moves sun like ball of poop. It's a living.
spokenText: What if Khepri, Resurrection Roll, retrieves card? Moves sun like ball of poop. It's a living.

card.name: Osiris (The Zombie Champ)
card.power: Undying Popularity: Cannot be eliminated. Just moves to the "Dead" pile and keeps scoring.
card.lore: First King. Got boxed, drowned, and chopped up. Still gets the biggest pop from the crowd.

line: Osiris, Undying Popularity: cannot be eliminated; boxed, drowned, chopped up, still biggest pop.
spokenText: Osiris, Undying Popularity: cannot be eliminated; boxed, drowned, chopped up, still biggest pop.

card.name: Isis (The Fixer)
card.power: Gather the Pieces: Reassemble a destroyed card.
card.lore: Queen of Magic. Conned the sun god for his password. Loyal to a fault.

line: Isis, Gather the Pieces: reassemble destroyed card; conned sun god for his password.
spokenText: Isis, Gather the Pieces: reassemble destroyed card; conned sun god for his password.

card.name: Set (The Heel)
card.power: Sandstorm Sabotage: Blind an opponent for one turn.
card.lore: Chaos Aardvark. Killed his brother over a chair shot. We all hate him; he loves it.

line: Set, Sandstorm Sabotage: blind opponent; killed brother over chair shot.
spokenText: Anyway, Set, Sandstorm Sabotage: blind opponent; killed brother over chair shot.

card.name: Horus (The Golden Boy)
card.power: Vengeance Strike: Double damage against "Heel" cards.
card.lore: The Falcon Heir. Fed his uncle a salad with a "secret ingredient." Issues.

line: Horus, Vengeance Strike: double damage against Heel cards; fed uncle salad, secret ingredient.
spokenText: Horus, Vengeance Strike: double damage against Heel cards; fed uncle salad, secret ingredient.

card.name: Anubis (The Bouncer)
card.power: Weighing Scale: Guess opponent's card value. If correct, eliminate it.
card.lore: God of Mummification. If your heart is heavy, you don't get into the club.

line: Anubis, Weighing Scale: guess card value, if correct, eliminate it; heavy heart, no club.
spokenText: Anubis, Weighing Scale: guess card value, if correct, eliminate it; heavy heart, no club.

card.name: Ma'at (The Rulebook)
card.power: Balance Check: Force all stats to become equal (average).
card.lore: Cosmic Order. The feather that ruins your afterlife. No cheating allowed.

line: Ma'at, Balance Check: equal stats; feather ruins afterlife, no cheating.
spokenText: No wait, Ma'at, Balance Check: equal stats; feather ruins afterlife, no cheating.

card.name: Ammit (The Disposal Unit)
card.power: Soul Crunch: Permanently remove a card from the game (eating it conceptually).
card.lore: The Devourer. Only eats the hearts of sinners. Zero calorie diet.

line: Ammit, Soul Crunch: permanently remove card; hearts of sinners, zero calorie diet.
spokenText: Ammit, Soul Crunch: permanently remove card; hearts of sinners, zero calorie diet.

card.name: Thoth (The Scorekeeper)
card.power: Wiki-Edit: Change the text of one card's Lore for the turn.
card.lore: Inventor of writing. Knows the cheat codes. Gambled with the moon and won.

line: Thoth, Wiki-Edit: change Lore; Inventor of writing, knows cheat codes.
spokenText: Thoth, Wiki-Edit: change Lore; Inventor of writing, knows cheat codes.

card.name: Sekhmet (The Drunk Tank)
card.power: Rage Virus: Attack every card on the table, including your own.
card.lore: The Eye of Ra. Tried to delete humanity. Stopped only by a keg of red beer.

line: Sekhmet, Rage Virus: attack every card including own; stopped by red beer.
spokenText: Before we continue, Sekhmet, Rage Virus: attack every card including own; stopped by red beer.

card.name: Bastet (The House Cat)
card.power: Claws & Cuddles: Heal one card or scratch one enemy.
card.lore: Goddess of perfume and ointment. Sekhmet on a 'good' day. Don't touch the belly.

line: Bastet, Claws & Cuddles: heal or scratch; don't touch belly.
spokenText: Bastet, Claws & Cuddles: heal or scratch; don't touch belly.

card.name: Montu (The Raging Bull)
card.power: Trample: Ignore defense stats.
card.lore: The War God. Represents the Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.

line: Montu, Trample: ignore defense; Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.
spokenText: Montu, Trample: ignore defense; Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.

card.name: Shezmu (The Presser)
card.power: The Squeeze: Convert defeated cards into "Perfume" tokens.
card.lore: God of wine and slaughter. Crushes skulls like grapes. A true artisan.

line: Shezmu, The Squeeze: defeated cards into Perfume; skulls like grapes.
spokenText: Not a metaphor: Shezmu, The Squeeze: defeated cards into Perfume; skulls like grapes.

card.name: Sobek (The Teeth)
card.power: Ambush Drag: Pull an opponent's card into the "River" zone (discard).
card.lore: Lord of Semen. Loves robbery. Eats tourists. A complex guy.

line: Sobek, Ambush Drag: pull opponent's card into River; loves robbery, eats tourists.
spokenText: Sobek, Ambush Drag: pull opponent's card into River; loves robbery, eats tourists.

card.name: Tawaret (The Heavy Hitter)
card.power: Mama Bear Smash: If a "Child" card is threatened, stats triple.
card.lore: Goddess of childbirth. Hippos kill more people than crocs. Do the math.

line: Tawaret, Mama Bear Smash: threatened Child, stats triple; hippos kill more people.
spokenText: Tawaret, Mama Bear Smash: threatened Child, stats triple; hippos kill more people.

card.name: Khnum (The Potter)
card.power: Clay Clone: Create a duplicate of any card in play.
card.lore: Moulds babies out of river mud. The original 3D printer.

line: Khnum, Clay Clone: duplicate any card; babies out of river mud, original 3D printer.
spokenText: The thing about Khnum, Clay Clone: duplicate any card; babies out of river mud, original 3D printer.

card.name: Hapi (The Flood)
card.power: High Water: Flood the board. All non-aquatic cards lose -2 stats.
card.lore: Intersex deity of the inundation. Brings the silt, brings the life, brings the wet socks.

line: Hapi, High Water: flood board; silt, life, wet socks.
spokenText: Hapi, High Water: flood board; silt, life, wet socks.

card.name: Bes (The Mascot)
card.power: Distraction Dance: Opponent cannot attack this turn due to laughing.
card.lore: Protector of households. Scares demons by being ugly and loud. A true hero.

line: Bes, Distraction Dance: cannot attack for laughing; ugly and loud, true hero.
spokenText: Bes, Distraction Dance: cannot attack for laughing; ugly and loud, true hero.

card.name: Medjed (The Sheet)
card.power: Laser Eyes: Shoot beams from eyes. Instant hit.
card.lore: The Smiter. He shoots with his eye. He is unseen. He is a meme.

line: Medjed, Laser Eyes: shoot beams from eyes; unseen Smiter.
spokenText: Everyone agrees: Medjed, Laser Eyes: shoot beams from eyes; unseen Smiter.

card.name: Babi (The Alpha)
card.power: Aggression: Attack immediately. Ask questions never.
card.lore: Chief of the Baboons. Eats entrails. His virility is the mast of the underworld ferry. Gross.

line: Babi, Aggression: attack immediately, ask questions never; eats entrails. Gross.
spokenText: Babi, Aggression: attack immediately, ask questions never; eats entrails. Gross.

card.name: Serket (The Stinger)
card.power: Venom Heal: Poison enemies or cure allies.
card.lore: She who tightens the throat. Doctors love her. Scorpions are just misunderstood land-lobsters.

line: Serket, Venom Heal: poison enemies or cure allies; misunderstood scorpions.
spokenText: Serket, Venom Heal: poison enemies or cure allies; misunderstood scorpions.

card.name: The Solar Barque (Tour Bus)
card.power: Night Travel: Skip the opponent's turn.
card.lore: Millions of years, zero maintenance. Defense against the dark snake.

line: The Solar Barque, Night Travel? Skip opponent's turn; millions of years, zero maintenance.
spokenText: Have you heard of The Solar Barque, Night Travel? Skip opponent's turn; millions of years, zero maintenance.

card.name: The Scales of Justice (The Ref's Tool)
card.power: Judgment: Compare stats. Lower stat is eliminated.
card.lore: No calibration needed. If you tilt it, the hippo eats you.

line: The Scales of Justice, Judgment: lower stat eliminated; hippo eats you if tilted.
spokenText: The Scales of Justice, Judgment: lower stat eliminated; hippo eats you if tilted.

card.name: The Crook & Flail (Title Belts)
card.power: Command: Control an opponent's card for one turn.
card.lore: Shepherd the people, beat the grain. The duality of management.

line: The Crook & Flail, Command: control opponent's card; shepherd people, beat grain.
spokenText: The Crook & Flail, Command: control opponent's card; shepherd people, beat grain.

card.name: The Eye of Ra (Heat Ray)
card.power: Solar Flare: Deal 10 damage to all "Chaos" type cards.
card.lore: Remote-controlled drone strike of the ancient world.

line: The Eye of Ra, Solar Flare: damage all Chaos cards; ancient remote-controlled drone strike.
spokenText: Let me tell you about The Eye of Ra, Solar Flare: damage all Chaos cards; ancient remote-controlled drone strike.

card.name: Seshat (The Architect)
card.power: Blueprint: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck.
card.lore: She notches your lifespan on a stick. Invented math. Wearing a skin of her own species? Punk.

line: Seshat, Blueprint: look at top cards; notches lifespan on stick, invented math.
spokenText: Seshat, Blueprint: look at top cards; notches lifespan on stick, invented math.

card.name: Ptah (The Creator)
card.power: Spoken Reality: Name a card. If opponent has it, they discard it.
card.lore: Thought the world into existence. The ultimate introvert creation myth.

line: Ptah, Spoken Reality: name card, opponent discards; thought world into existence.
spokenText: Ptah, Spoken Reality: name card, opponent discards; thought world into existence.

card.name: Imhotep (The Ascended Fan)
card.power: Polymath: Can use the Power of any other "Manager" card.
card.lore: Was a mortal, built a pyramid, got promoted to God. The corporate ladder works.

line: Imhotep, Polymath: use Manager power; mortal built pyramid, promoted to God.
spokenText: This one has a rule: Imhotep, Polymath: use Manager power; mortal built pyramid, promoted to God.

card.name: Neith (The Weaver)
card.power: Fate Weave: Rearrange the order of any player's hand.
card.lore: The terrifying one. Wove the universe. Mothers crocodiles. Do not ask her to knit you a sweater.

line: Neith, Fate Weave: rearrange hand; wove universe, do not ask her to knit.
spokenText: Neith, Fate Weave: rearrange hand; wove universe, do not ask her to knit.

card.name: Apep (The Glitch)
card.power: System Crash: End the game. Nobody wins unless Ra is in play.
card.lore: The World Encircler. Ra's umbilical cord gone wrong. Pray AGAINST him.

line: Apep, System Crash: end game, nobody wins unless Ra in play; pray against him.
spokenText: Apep, System Crash: end game, nobody wins unless Ra in play; pray against him.

card.name: The Akhekh (The Griffin-ish)
card.power: Desert Terror: Apply "Fear" status to opponent.
card.lore: Desert dweller. A visual non-sequitur designed to scare tourists.

line: The Akhekh, Desert Terror: Fear status; visual non-sequitur scares tourists.
spokenText: Nobody warned us about The Akhekh, Desert Terror: Fear status; visual non-sequitur scares tourists.

card.name: Seven Scorpions (The Posse)
card.power: Swarm: 7 small attacks instead of 1 big one.
card.lore: Isis's bodyguards. They stung a rich lady's son because she was rude. Class warfare.

line: Seven Scorpions, Swarm: 7 small attacks; bodyguards, they stung rich lady's son.
spokenText: Seven Scorpions, Swarm: 7 small attacks; bodyguards, they stung rich lady's son.

card.name: The Red Cloud (Storm Front)
card.power: Blindness: All accuracy stats reduced to zero.
card.lore: The angry breath of Set. Red is the color of bad things in the desert.

line: The Red Cloud, Blindness: accuracy zero; angry breath of Set, red is color of bad things.
spokenText: The Red Cloud, Blindness: accuracy zero; angry breath of Set, red is color of bad things.

card.name: Nekhbet (South)
card.power: White Crown: +5 Defense if played with Wadjet.
card.lore: Patron of Upper Egypt. Vultures are good mothers. It's a cultural thing.

line: Nekhbet, White Crown: defense with Wadjet; vultures good mothers.
spokenText: The deck insists on Nekhbet, White Crown: defense with Wadjet; vultures good mothers.

card.name: Wadjet (North)
card.power: Red Crown: +5 Attack if played with Nekhbet.
card.lore: Patron of Lower Egypt. Fire-spitting snake. Put her on your forehead for protection.

line: Wadjet, Red Crown: attack with Nekhbet; fire-spitting snake, forehead protection.
spokenText: Wadjet, Red Crown: attack with Nekhbet; fire-spitting snake, forehead protection.

card.name: Shai (Destiny)
card.power: The Script: Decide the outcome of a dice roll before rolling.
card.lore: The concept of Fate. You can't fight the booking committee.

line: Shai, The Script: decide dice outcome before rolling; can't fight booking committee.
spokenText: Shai, The Script: decide dice outcome before rolling; can't fight booking committee.

card.name: Renenutet (The Nurse)
card.power: Harvest Gold: Gain resources each turn.
card.lore: Goddess of the harvest and nursing. Snakes and milk. Don't think about it too hard.

line: Renenutet, Harvest Gold: resources each turn; snakes and milk.
spokenText: Which brings us to Renenutet, Harvest Gold: resources each turn; snakes and milk.

card.name: The Duat (Backstage Area)
card.power: Graveyard cards can attack from here.
card.lore: The Underworld. Dangerous, full of snakes, and you have to pass 12 gates to leave.

line: The Duat, Graveyard cards attack; Underworld snakes, 12 gates to leave.
spokenText: The Duat, Graveyard cards attack; Underworld snakes, 12 gates to leave.

card.name: The Field of Reeds (VIP Lounge)
card.power: Heal all damage at end of turn.
card.lore: Aaru. The goal. It's just like Earth but you don't have to pay taxes.

line: The Field of Reeds, heal all damage at end of turn; Aaru, just like Earth but no taxes.
spokenText: Meanwhile elsewhere, The Field of Reeds, heal all damage at end of turn; Aaru, just like Earth but no taxes.

card.name: Heliopolis (The Main Stage)
card.power: Solar gods get +2 Stats.
card.lore: City of the Sun. Where the Ennead holds their board meetings.

line: Heliopolis, Solar gods get Stats; Ennead board meetings.
spokenText: Heliopolis, Solar gods get Stats; Ennead board meetings.

card.name: The Primeval Mound (The Ring Mat)
card.power: First card played gets "High Ground" advantage.
card.lore: The first solid ground. Everything starts here. King of the Hill rules apply.

line: The Primeval Mound, High Ground? First solid ground; everything starts here.
spokenText: Do you know The Primeval Mound, High Ground? First solid ground; everything starts here.

card.name: The Lettuce Incident
card.power: Public Humiliation: Opponent loses all "Cool" points.
card.lore: Set ate salad with Horus's... dressing. A gold disk appeared on his head. Awkward.

line: The Lettuce Incident, Public Humiliation: opponent loses Cool points; Set ate salad with Horus's dressing. Awkward.
spokenText: The Lettuce Incident, Public Humiliation: opponent loses Cool points; Set ate salad with Horus's dressing. Awkward.

card.name: The Red Beer Trick
card.power: Forced Sleep: Remove the strongest attacker from play.
card.lore: She thought it was blood. It was dyed beer. The original hangover.

line: The Red Beer Trick, Forced Sleep: strongest attacker removed; thought blood, dyed beer.
spokenText: The Red Beer Trick, Forced Sleep: strongest attacker removed; thought blood, dyed beer.

card.name: The Missing Piece
card.power: Prosthetic Power: Replace a lost limb with gold (+5 stats).
card.lore: Isis found 13 pieces of Osiris. The fish ate the 14th. Had to make a gold replacement.

line: The Missing Piece, Prosthetic Power: replace lost limb with gold; fish ate the 14th.
spokenText: Welcome to The Missing Piece, Prosthetic Power: replace lost limb with gold; fish ate the 14th.

card.name: The Extra 5 Days
card.power: Overtime: Take an extra turn.
card.lore: Nut couldn't give birth in the 360 day year. Thoth won 5 extra days gambling. Loophole!

line: The Extra 5 Days, Overtime: extra turn; Thoth won 5 extra days gambling.
spokenText: The Extra 5 Days, Overtime: extra turn; Thoth won 5 extra days gambling.
